title: Midday microdeploy comm-lane and release notes sketch
body:
Context:
This is an operational scratchpad for a planned midday microdeploy window. Focus: low-risk feature toggle flip for routing heuristics + a small observability agent bump. Goal is <30m change window, 1% initial traffic with 10m ramp. This doc bundles the checklist, hour-by-hour calendar, and a terse release notes draft for immediate copy/paste to changelog.

Why midday?
- Several product teams requested a mid-day push to align with partner testing in EMEA.
- Traffic shape is stable; we have an observability dry-run scheduled at 11:30 UTC.
- This is explicitly NOT a heavy release; keep blast radius small.

Quick risk summary:
- Low: feature is behind toggle and only affects routing policy for fallback models.
- Medium: agent bump includes telemetry schema change requiring a small mapping in pipeline (backwards compatible).
- Mitigation: canary at 1%, auto-fallback to previous routing on error, removal of schema-level fields is guarded by version check.

Communication plan (who says what):
- Release lead (Aisha): start-of-window Slack ping to #release-ops and #sre-runway, include quick checklist and watchlist.
- Observability (Maya): confirm dashboards and synthetic probes green; post snapshot link.
- Platform oncall (Evan): final signoff 10m prior, stand-by for rollback.
- Customer Success: short heads-up to any customers in pilot cohort (Diego owners) 30m before.

Post-deploy comms: brief summary in #release-ops and update the incident page only if rollback triggered.

Notes to operators: stick to the kill-switch policy: if latency p50 increases >40ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate >0.5% on route, trigger rollback.

Operational artifacts below: checklist (actionable), calendar (minute-by-minute), release_notes_draft (to paste into changelog).
checklist: Pre-window (T-120 to T-30): announce window in #release-ops and add message to #product-staff; confirm CS list for pilot customers
T-60: confirm canary config created (1% traffic, region filter: eu-west-1 only)
T-45: health checks smoke (integration smoke: auth, kv-cache, rerank), confirm synthetic probes green
T-30: toggle ready, config version bumped in infra (config id: cfg-2026-06-midday-1)
T-15: final signoff from SRE and Observability leads; ensure runbook visible and operator assigned
T-05: Slack heads-up: deploying now (include linked artifacts and short rollback steps)
T+00: flip toggle to canary, verify 1% traffic landed; check p50/p95, error rate, and kv-hit ratio
T+05: expand to 5% only if metrics stable; otherwise hold and investigate
T+15: expand to 25% if stable for last 10m; watch cross-region ripple for any regressions
T+30: full rollout to configured capacity OR halt and open triage if thresholds exceeded
Rollback ladder: immediate revert toggle -> disable new agent -> promote hotfix branch; notify stakeholders and create postmortem if revert triggered
Post-window (T+60): capture telemetry snapshot and store artifacts (screenshot dashboards, trace ids, logs), notify CS of success or issues
Retro: collect quick notes in this doc and schedule 30m retro within 24 hours
calendar_summary: 2026-06-27 midday microdeploy (target window 13:00-14:00 UTC). 12:00 UTC - preflight announce; 12:30 - smoke tests; 12:45 - signoffs; 13:00 - canary flip to 1%; progressive ramp at +5m, +15m, +30m. Primary region: eu-west-1. Observability lead on deck: Maya. Platform oncall: Evan.
release_notes_draft:
Draft for changelog:
- routing: introduced conditional fallback bias tuning behind toggle (canary first). Improves latency for short-sequence queries by ~5-10% in eu-west; under toggle control.
- observability: agent v2.3.1 bump — added optional telemetry fields for KV cache hits (backwards compatible).
- misc: minor config hygiene (cleaned stale route entries).

Known limitations:
- telemetry fields are optional; downstream pipelines ignoring unmapped fields will log a schema warning but should not fail.

How to cite this release in internal notes: MIDDAY-2026-06-27: routing toggle + obs-agent v2.3.1 (canary 1% -> progressive).
